title: Three Terms and One Short Map
subtitle: 学科学习 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 学科学习（人与自我·生活与学习·丰富、充实、积极向上的生活）
meta: 主题语境：学科学习（人与自我·生活与学习·丰富、充实、积极向上的生活）　|　核心词汇：geography　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 geography 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1970 the teacher ① taught the geography that no inspector in the school would have described, and he said the teaching was the whole of the term. The ② geography, meaning the subject itself and not the map, ran three terms and stayed undescribed in the book; geography, he said, is the only thing in a school that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ lesson of geography in that school had the same short map beside it, and the ④ geography at the far wall, meaning the chart they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Geography, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the teacher said the describing is the part that fills three terms.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the geography was the whole of the matter, meaning the terrain and not the subject. The ⑥ geography, meaning the terrain and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; geography, he said, is either something you teach or the only word that means both a subject and a terrain. He said the terrain is the part they remember.

By 1975 the ⑦ geography had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short map. The ⑧ geography of the whole thing, the teacher wrote in November, was one school and three terms of describing; geography, he said, is either the chart at the far wall or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ geography I remember is the chart described in the plan, which closed in 1977 and is still described as the quietest in the school. ⑩ Geography, my mother said in 1979, is the only subject that improves by being described; all geography, she said, is a terrain that has agreed to look like a subject. She said the terrain was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 地理；地理课（指学校里每一课旁边的那一课）
B. n. 地理；地理学（指这门学科本身，与地图相对）
C. 固定搭配：teach the geography 教地理
D. n. 地理（指留给孩子们看的那张挂图）
E. n. 地理（抽象总称，指一所学校的地理教学之事）
F. n. 地理（指方案里写到、被记录过的那张图）
G. n. 地形；地貌（the geography of the region，指一件事里人人都走却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 地势（抽象总称，指人人都走却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: taught the geography that no inspector in the school would have described
The geography, meaning the subject itself and not the map

the geography at the far wall

answers.why: teach the geography 意为“教地理”，1970 年那位老师教了学校里没有一位督学肯描述的地理课。
geography 意为“地理、地理学”，指这门学科本身而不是地图，它经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被描述。
geography 意为“地理课”，指学校里每一课旁边的那一课，每一课旁边都有同一张矮矮的地图。
geography 意为“地理”，指最远那面墙上留给孩子们看的那张挂图，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
geography 意为“地形、地貌”，指一件事里人人都走却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这片地貌就是那件事的全部。
geography 意为“地势”，指人人都走却无人提起的那样东西而不是这门学科，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
geography 意为“地理”，指方案里写到、被记录过的那张图，到 1975 年这张图成了方案里的一行。
geography 意为“地理”，老师十一月写道，整件事的地理教学之事是一所学校和三个学期的描述。
geography 意为“地理”，我记得的是方案里描述过的那张挂图，1977 年换下了，至今仍被说成学校里最安静的一张。
geography 为抽象总称，母亲 1979 年说，地理是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的学科。
